claim:adhesion-calibration.proposition: A mechanics-only neutral sheet, compiled from one blueprint onto both backends, reaches COMPARABLE cell-shape statistics on the CPM and vertex substrates. The neutral adhesion strength lowers DIRECTLY to the CPM contact energy J and MONOTONICALLY to the vertex line tension; the J<->tension mapping is directional (same sign), not a sharply pinned constant at this scale.

claim:initial-state-fidelity.proposition: Both backends reproduce the blueprint's t=0 state -- every cell's centroid, size and type -- when the one backend-neutral blueprint is compiled onto each. The CPM side is EXACT (centroid residual 0); the vertex side is within a sub-cell residual (RMS ~1.2 um) and achieves a clean 1:1 identity for every cell (fraction_clean 1.0).

claim:flu-lung-crossparadigm.proposition: The ONE backend-neutral Sego 2022 influenza blueprint compiles to BOTH the CPM (viva-cpm) and vertex (vivarium-tyssue) substrates and runs the FULL model end-to-end on each. Because the field / rules / systemic-ODE / recruitment mechanism is shared byte-for-byte across the two compiles, we test for a substrate effect against a NULL CONTROL (same-backend seed-to-seed spread). On cell fate and infected-patch LOCATION the cross-backend difference sits inside the same-backend seed spread, so at this scale and seed count we FAIL TO REJECT the null (no detectable substrate effect -- NOT proof of equality). The one exception is raw infected-patch occupancy IoU, which trends ~25-35% below both same-backend baselines -- a candidate weak substrate signal to test at larger scale / more vertex seeds.

claim:dose-response-crossparadigm.proposition: Both backends agree on the DIRECTION of the dose response: a HIGHER initial viral load (more initially-infected epithelial cells) ends with STRICTLY more infection than a LOWER load, on every backend and seed tested. This is a directional (lowest-vs-highest) result; intermediate-dose monotonicity is seed-dependent and is NOT claimed.

pass_if.note: final(0.15) > final(0.03) for cpm/vertex x seeds {0,1}

narrative.question: Can ONE backend-neutral blueprint express the whole Sego 2022 influenza model (ViralInfectionVTM) and run it faithfully on two different mechanical substrates — a Cellular Potts model (viva-cpm) and a vertex model (vivarium-tyssue) — and where do the two substrates agree vs diverge when the shared mechanism is driven live?

decisions.title: Raw infected-patch occupancy IoU trends ~25-35% below both same-backend baselines (cross 0.165 vs CPM 0.249 / vertex 0.212) — a CANDIDATE weak substrate signal. Test it at a LARGER scale (where the vertex side is no longer near-degenerate across seeds) before calling it signal or noise.
ODE inputs V/L/C/F have no producer (Task 21) — the immune arm is barely exercised at this scale; land the producers to drive recruitment.
Immune recruitment is a latent-pool approximation (T20-RECRUIT) — confirm this is the intended mechanism or replace with topology insertion.
Sego acceptance bands are the CPM stochastic envelope, not digitized Sego 2022 figures — digitize the paper curves for a literature band.
The J<->tension calibration is directional, not pinned — decide whether a sharper calibration (larger sheet) is worth it.
